items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I was on a date with Rickie Lee Jones. They called me to put a bass line and a tuba line for some things she had done.

ctx.x: I have predicted a few hits. For instance, a few years ago I was on a date with Rickie Lee Jones. They called me to put a bass line and a tuba line for some things she had done. This was for Warner's. I said, 'This girl is going to be a hit.' And she is.
